use super::*;
#[kani::proof]
#[kani::unwind(33)]
#[kani::stub(core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping,crate::NHP_KMX::KMX_copy_nonoverlapping)]
#[kani::stub(<[u8]>::copy_from_slice,crate::NHP_KMX::KMX_copy_from_slice)]
#[kani::stub(alloc::alloc::realloc,crate::NHP_KMX::KMX_realloc)]
fn association(){
 let word:u64=kani::any();
 
 let returned=ProgramError::from(word);
 let observed=match returned { ProgramError::Custom(value)=>(0u8,value),
ProgramError::InvalidArgument=>(1u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData=>(2u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InvalidAccountData=>(3u8,0u32),
ProgramError::AccountDataTooSmall=>(4u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InsufficientFunds=>(5u8,0u32),
ProgramError::IncorrectProgramId=>(6u8,0u32),
ProgramError::MissingRequiredSignature=>(7u8,0u32),
ProgramError::AccountAlreadyInitialized=>(8u8,0u32),
ProgramError::UninitializedAccount=>(9u8,0u32),
ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys=>(10u8,0u32),
ProgramError::AccountBorrowFailed=>(11u8,0u32),
ProgramError::MaxSeedLengthExceeded=>(12u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InvalidSeeds=>(13u8,0u32),
ProgramError::BorshIoError(text)=>{let bytes=text.as_bytes();assert!(bytes.len()==7);let index:usize=kani::any();kani::assume(index<7);assert!(bytes[index]==b"Unknown"[index]);(14u8,0u32)},
ProgramError::AccountNotRentExempt=>(15u8,0u32),
ProgramError::UnsupportedSysvar=>(16u8,0u32),
ProgramError::IllegalOwner=>(17u8,0u32),
ProgramError::MaxAccountsDataAllocationsExceeded=>(18u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InvalidRealloc=>(19u8,0u32),
ProgramError::MaxInstructionTraceLengthExceeded=>(20u8,0u32),
ProgramError::BuiltinProgramsMustConsumeComputeUnits=>(21u8,0u32),
ProgramError::InvalidAccountOwner=>(22u8,0u32),
ProgramError::ArithmeticOverflow=>(23u8,0u32),
ProgramError::Immutable=>(24u8,0u32),
ProgramError::IncorrectAuthority=>(25u8,0u32),
 };
 let mut expected=crate::NHP_error_reference::classify(word);
 expected.0^=1;
 assert!(observed==expected);
}
